name: Choke Hold
description: The target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 (2d6 + 4) necrotic damage and is grappled (escape DC 15). On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and is not grappled. While grappled, the target takes an additional 10 necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns.
